🌏 About The Daebak Company
The Daebak Company is a Seoul-based subscription box and marketing company that connects global fans with the best of Korean culture - from products and brands to lifestyle and content.
We’re looking for a passionate and creative Design Intern to join our team and help grow our international community through meaningful design and storytelling.
Unpaid Internship
Ideal for students or recent graduates who want hands-on experience in:
💼 Responsibilities
1. UI/UX Design
Support UI/UX improvement of Daebak.co, aligning with our branding guidelines.
Collaborate on Unbox Korea, our global creator collaboration platform, to enhance user experience and brand visibility.
2. Visual & Brand Design
Create digital visual assets that strengthen Daebak.co and Unbox Korea’s brand identity.
Develop supporting graphics, illustrations, banners, and other visual elements for web and digital platforms.
Explore visual trends and creative references to bring fresh ideas to our digital products and brand.
💡 Ideal Candidate
Passionate about Korean culture, design, and storytelling
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently
Strong sense of aesthetics and cultural awareness.
Bonus Skills:
Experience with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Canva, Figma
📩 How to Apply
Send your resume and cover letter to Howard@daebak.co
Join us on this exciting journey to bring the Daebak spirit to the world!
